sections.summary: REPLACE: Plain-language summary with the key information on the issuer, the token, holder rights, principal risks, and the redemption procedure. Art. 6 Abs. 7 MiCAR expects a summary a retail reader can follow; the linter expects at least 80 words.
sections.risk_warning: REPLACE: The mandatory risk warning under Art. 6 Abs. 5 MiCAR — loss of value, transferability limits, liquidity, no deposit-guarantee or investor-compensation coverage.
sections.management_statement: REPLACE: Statement of the management body that the white paper complies with MiCAR and that the information is fair, clear, and not misleading (Art. 6 Abs. 6 MiCAR). The linter checks for the statutory formula.
sections.notification_date: REPLACE: Date of notification to the competent authority (Art. 8 Abs. 1 MiCAR).
sections.language: REPLACE: State the language of the white paper and why it satisfies Art. 6 Abs. 12 MiCAR (official language of the home Member State or a language customary in international finance).
sections.issuer: REPLACE: Legal form, registered seat, register number, governance, and management-body experience of the issuer (Anhang II Teil A MiCAR for ARTs).
sections.art: REPLACE: Description of the asset-referenced token, the reference assets, and the stabilisation mechanism.
sections.offer_or_admission: REPLACE: Terms of the offer to the public or admission to trading — addressees, price, subscription mechanics, target market.
sections.rights_and_obligations: REPLACE: Rights and obligations of the holder, including the redemption right at par under Art. 39 MiCAR, complaint procedures, and any transfer restrictions.
sections.technology: REPLACE: Description of the underlying technology — consensus mechanism, smart contract governance, custody of keys, audits.
sections.risks: REPLACE: Principal risks — market, credit, liquidity, de-peg, operational, and regulatory risk, plus the reserve-impairment cure procedure.
sections.reserve_of_assets: REPLACE: Composition, custody, segregation, valuation, and audit of the reserve of assets.
sections.environmental_impact: REPLACE: Principal adverse impacts on the climate of the consensus mechanism, per the ESMA sustainability-indicator RTS.
sections.redemption: REPLACE: Redemption procedure — how, when, at what cost, and under which narrow conditions redemption may be suspended.
